sentences.text: Researchers analyzed blood samples from 57 adults with mild to moderate facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy who could walk without assistance, comparing them to a control group of individuals matched by age and sex but without the disease.
The analysis revealed 57 specific chemicals that differed between the patients and controls, suggesting disruptions in energy production, stress responses, and muscle maintenance.
The authors conclude that these metabolic changes are present early in the disease, even when symptoms are only mild to moderate.
